blind.description: A realistic human skull resting directly on the ground. It features anatomically detailed bone structures including the cranium, brow ridge, eye sockets (orbits), nasal cavity, cheekbones, and upper and lower jaws with teeth. The surface is smooth and continuous with fine suture lines visible on the top of the skull, showing an aged bone or beige/tan material. It rests stably on its base without any stand or plinth.
blind.from_above: An oval-shaped cranium with a visible sagittal/coronal suture pattern, tapering slightly toward the anterior/brow at the bottom of the frame.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/8 to 1/9 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7 to 9 inches tall and wide, life-sized for a human skull).
